review_evidence: README identifies the project as a Lean library for interacting with the Lurk language.

A complete scan of all 18 Lean files found 259 declaration-style lines. Lurk/Expr.lean defines the language syntax (atoms, unary/binary operations, lambda, application, let/letrec, quote and eval), while Lurk/Eval.lean defines environments, values and the evaluator.

The repository also defines LDON/light-data representations, parsing, scalar/field operations and SSA-related transformations. These are reusable language-semantics/formal-interface prior art even though this snapshot has no theorem/lemma declarations.
summary: Reviewed Lurk.lean and retain its formal Lurk syntax, values, environments, evaluator, parser, and language transformations.
